label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: The claim implies a no-harm standard, but the report records 29 total recordable injuries, 2 lost time injuries, and 1 case of work-related ill-health in FY25.
llm_reason: The claim asserts a belief that no injury or harm to health is acceptable and that all activities are undertaken without compromising health and safety. The evidence provides only numerical counts of injuries and ill-health cases (29 total recordable injuries, 2 lost time injuries, 1 recordable ill-health case), which directly contradict the claim's assertion of zero harm. The evidence does not support the claim's decisive assertion of no injuries or harm.
